info.name: 📌 Together AI API
info.description:
### About Together AI

"Build what's next on the AI Native Cloud."

Together AI runs open models from other labs, such as DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi and GLM, through an OpenAI-compatible API, plus fine-tuning and batch. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Inference hosts**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Together AI Account: [https://api.together.xyz/](https://api.together.xyz/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `together_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:together_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://docs.together.ai/reference](https://docs.together.ai/reference)
    
- Models: [https://api.together.xyz/models](https://api.together.xyz/models)
